additional_info.subject: RE: ID0421387-DC/Si-D/NZ-[MP / N5 160345946]unable to charge CRM:02681000112
additional_info.body:
Hey Liz,
Hope you are doing well.
Based on our discussion this morning, you mentioned the door was pressed more firmly and the charger was power cycled, which appeared to make it operational.
Our global team determined that the coolant level flag was low and there was also a potential issue with the communication to one of the power converters.
Could you provide us an update on how charger is operating now and if you require further assistance or analysis of the initial fault?
With Kind Regards,
Ferdinand Reisch
Siemens Ltd.
Application Service Engineer
Email: ferdinand.reisch@siemens.com
www.siemens.com.au/emobility

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0421387-DC/Si-D/NZ-[MP / N5 160345946]unable to charge CRM:02681000112
additional_info.body:
Hey Liz,
Just wanted to inform you that this case will now be closed.
Problem Description:
CCS2 non-operational and OCPP offline
Resolution:
Charger door was opened and closed and local power cycle was carried out.
No further root cause investigation requested.
If you need any further assistance, you can get in contact with us here → www.siemens.com/emobility-service-request
